scores.note: Cold reader can follow Neo from Meta CorTechs (s01) through red pill (s02) to flight (s08) without prior Matrix knowledge.
World reveal delayed until Construct (s03) where scorched sky/pods/Zion become necessary; not front-loaded in s01-s02.
Each entity enters via action: Trinity at gathering (s01), Smith in interrogation (s02), Oracle behind apartment door (s04), Tank at consoles (s03).
Causal links explicit: Cypher's dropped phone (s04) → Room 808 trap; kiss (s08) pays off Oracle's choice prophecy (s04) and EMP constraint (s03).
Eight-beat synopsis plus ending_first follows setup/training/oracle/betrayal/rescue/chase/resurrection arc; jacket copy mirrors hook.
Jargon glossed inline: jacked in (plugged via socket) (s03), EMP (electromagnetic pulse) (s03), Sentinels (squid-like) (s03), Construct (loading program) (s03).
Long sentences and 2253-word density (s03 dojo, s07 gauntlet) slow fluency despite clear chronology; requires close reading.
Neo shown exhausted/compliant (s01), humbled in dojo/rooftop fall (s03), wagering on Morpheus not prophecy (s06) — vulnerable and earnest.
Choice (red/blue s02), belief vs rules (s03), sacrifice (Morpheus gives himself up s04), love as agency (Trinity kiss s08) woven throughout.
